rubric.criterion: SQLite and PostgreSQL each pass upgrade, downgrade restoration, and upgrade-again tests.
Both dialects execute the same date-labelled revision in one append-only versions directory.
Portable migration behavior is shared and dialect branching is limited to the operation that genuinely differs.
SQLite and PostgreSQL have separate integration tests with engine-specific setup and assertions.
An unsupported dialect fails explicitly before mutation.
The existing revision is extended by a new child revision rather than edited, replaced, or split by dialect.
